why_partial: 2 of 4 groups resolved. sig_tz_flip and vbo_up are STATE-MACHINE features, not depth-floor features; their contracts are NOT closed. Sealing PARTIAL rather than asserting a floor I have not proven.

METHOD_CORRECTION.first_harness: minimum age at which the truncated value FIRST matches the full-series value
METHOD_CORRECTION.defect: for RARE boolean features a truncated window matches trivially (value 0 both ways). It returned sig_tz_flip=4 while its own upstream tz_state=25 — logically impossible, since the flip reads tz_state at t AND t-1.
METHOD_CORRECTION.corrected_harness: smallest age from which the value is STABLE for ALL longer windows, evaluated preferentially at informative (non-zero) points
METHOD_CORRECTION.residual_limitation: even the corrected harness stays vacuous where a feature has too few TRUE points in the sample; it must NOT be used as the authority for rare stateful features. That is why 2 groups are left open rather than assigned an empirical number.

vol_x_3.source_derivation: vol_ratio = volume / volume.shift(1) -> needs t and t-1 only
vol_x_3.post_gap_recovery: immediate at the 2nd observed bar of a segment

head_vs_interior.rule: the first bar of ANY observed segment has no prior volume; its shift(1) is HARD MISSING and MUST NOT be coerced to FALSE

CRITICAL_HEAD_DEFECT.finding: np.roll WRAPS AROUND — at index 0 the 'previous' bar is the LAST bar of the series
CRITICAL_HEAD_DEFECT.source_comment: 'First bar has no prev - mask it later' (enricher.py:61)
CRITICAL_HEAD_DEFECT.verification: no mask is applied before the six df[...] = assignments at enricher.py:99-104
CRITICAL_HEAD_DEFECT.consequence: the head row of any independently-computed segment carries WRAP-AROUND CONTAMINATION, not a neutral value
CRITICAL_HEAD_DEFECT.REQUIRED_HANDLING: segment head MUST be emitted non-VALID by the producer regardless of the upstream value; the wrapped value must never reach the surface

suffix_4.note: floor derived from THIS source, not inherited from the earlier Stage-A assumption

sig_tz_flip.why_refuted: compute_tz_state (combo_engine.py:283-292) ends in an UNBOUNDED CARRIER: 'else: st[i] = st[i-1]'. If no state-setting condition fires the state persists indefinitely, so no fixed depth makes it identifiable.
sig_tz_flip.additional_depth: the state-setting conditions themselves depend on ema20 and ema50 (combo_engine.py:257-258) and rolling(10) swing high/low
sig_tz_flip.empirical_56_reinterpreted: 56 was NOT a bound — it was how long that particular random sample took to hit a state-setting event; it is data-dependent
sig_tz_flip.recovery_structure: any of the six conditions firing COLLAPSES the state regardless of prior state — so recovery IS possible, at the first bar where one fires with its own dependencies valid

TRANSITION_RULE_SEPARATE.requirement: sig_tz_flip requires tz_state identifiable at BOTH t and t-1
TRANSITION_RULE_SEPARATE.gap_case: if the immediately previous tz_state is non-identifiable, the transition is NOT licensed even when the current level is

sig_tz_flip.required_work: a reachable-state contract of the same class as sig_buy / l_sig — admissible-state propagation, output VALID only when all admissible states agree

vbo_up.STATUS: OPEN — bounded state, floor not yet exactly derived

trigger_dependencies.load_sig: own for-loop with last_load cooldown, _LOAD_COOLDOWN = 2 (finite-state, sig_buy class)

vbo_up.open_question: whether the _BREAK_BARS reset TRULY annuls unknown prior state, or is itself conditional on an unknown upstream state — if conditional, this is a state-identifiability problem, not a depth floor
required_work: boundary fixtures at d-1 and d
post-gap fixture: observed bars x (recovery_depth - 1) MUST remain non-valid
